newsitem.title: LEBANON: Roadside bomb wounds three people in south Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Roadside bomb wounds three people in south Lebanon.

text.p: A roadside bomb wounded three people in south Lebanon on Monday, pro-Israeli militia sources said.
The victims were travelling in a car that triggered the bomb just north of Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone, the sources said without elaborating.

Pro-Iranian Hizbollah (Party of God) guerrillas are fighting to drive Israeli forces and their local militia allies from the 15 km (nine-mile) wide zone, site of frequent clashes, roadside bombs and rocket attacks.
